messages:
Maya: Quick check — Zenith (enterprise) signed contract for adaptive-batching. Want to enable per-tenant flag now so they can test. Can we do a 100% enable for them + small internal canary?
Arjun: +1. Which flag key are we using?
Maya: adaptive_batching_v2. We'll need a tenant-scoped allowlist entry and contract gating so it doesn't leak to non-contract accounts.
Lia: Do we have the contract ID mapping in tenant-config? If not, we should avoid manual changes.
Samir: We don't yet. There's an upcoming migration to add contract_id on tenants (PR #4567). That needs to land before we rely on contract gating.
Maya: Ok noted. Short term: can we add Zenith to per-tenant override table and add a feature_toggle row?
Arjun: Yes. Ops runbook: add row in admin UI -> Feature toggles -> tenant_override for tenant_id=zenith-001, flag=adaptive_batching_v2, value=true. Add audit note.
Lia: Also request telemetry: track p50/p95 latency, token-per-request cost, and error rate. Create a dashboard slice for Zenith specifically.
Samir: I'll wire up the dashboard. Need the flag-emitted metric tag — should we emit tenant_id and flag_version?
Maya: Emit tenant_id and flag_variant. Flag_version helpful for rollbacks.
Arjun: Canary plan: 10% internal traffic (use dev org slice), 100% for Zenith. Monitor for 30m, if token cost > +15% or errors +3x, kill.
Lia: Who has kill authority? SOS channel + ops paging?
Samir: Ops on-call will watch. Also add a kill-switch flag: tenant_override_disable.adaptive_batching_v2. If set true, overrides are ignored.
Maya: Good call. Add that to the admin UI and docs.
OpsBot: Reminder: please follow rollout checklist: create allowlist entry, update dashboard, confirm PRs merged, post in #incidents if anomalies.
Arjun: PRs: feature-flag-store#789 (per-tenant override), ui-admin#432 (tenant toggle UI), infra-mig#4567 (tenant.contract_id). Link: https://git.redwood/feature-flag-store/pulls/789
Maya: Pinged reviewers on the three PRs. Arjun, can you own the DB change rollout?
Arjun: I can. I'll coordinate a quick migration window, low traffic hours. ETA tonight 11pm PT.
Lia: I'll approve the UI change after Arjun confirms migration completes.
Samir: Once PRs merged, ops can add Zenith entry. Ops, confirm you have tenant_id and contact email for alerting.
Maya: Zenith tenant_id is zenith-001 and support@zenith.com is primary. Confirmed with AE.
OpsBot: DeployBot scheduled a canary deployment for flag runtime at 23:30 PT if PRs are merged. Deploy ID: deploy-202363.
DeployBot: Canaries will run on staging-internal -> prod-canary. Automated rollback triggers: 504 spike > 2% or error budget > 5% in 5m.
Samir: I'll add the dashboard alerts and a slack alert to #eng-platform.
Arjun: After migration, add a migration safety tag: run with --dry-run for first 10 tenants then full backfill.
Maya: Quick checklist for ops to execute after merge: 1) run migration dry-run, 2) create tenant_override for zenith-001, 3) enable kill-switch rule, 4) enable telemetry tags, 5) announce in slack with timeframe.
Lia: Also update the contract gating doc with the process and list of config keys.
Maya: Assigning owners: Arjun (migration + DB), Samir (dashboards + alerts), Lia (doc + approval), Ops (tenant entry + guardrails). I'll be point for customer comms.
Arjun: Noted, will push migration tonight and post status here.
Samir: Dashboard PR opened: infra-observability#210.
Maya: Thanks — once everything is green we'll do the Zenith enable. No experimental rollout to other tenants until contract_id gating is in place.
Lia: One more: add an audit log entry requirement for any per-tenant toggle change (who, why, ticket). Ops, can you enforce?
Samir: Ops can require a ticket ID in the admin UI field — will enforce via validation.
OpsBot: Action items logged: MIGRATE-456, DASH-210, UI-432, PR-789, DEPLOY-202363.
Maya: Perfect. If anyone sees blockers, drop them here. Otherwise we'll proceed on the timeline. :thumbsup:
